answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy gives each newcomer a walnut probation tier and locks a bond for 24 epochs. Three random auditors reproduce distinct tasks; a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. A ledge sponsor quota permits only two new identities per epoch, while a jade registry compares signed output fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Full rewards unlock after seven clean rounds, making fake identities costly and slow; task hashes keep every decision auditable.
